workload.description: reduced Tate pairing t_r(P, phi(R)) on supersingular y^2=x^3+x over F_p, p the first prime c*r - 1 with 4 | c (58 bits), r the largest prime below 2^52 (the eds_mov k=2 path at a larger size)
curve_ids: y^2=x^3+x over F_p (p = c*r - 1, r = largest prime below 2^52)

metric: F_p M-equivalents per pairing loop (M + S + I x Fermat cost)
note: Deterministic counts; the repo's affine Miller loop (eds_mov::miller_fp2, ported to the counting field) counts 22757 M-eq with 194 inversions. Cubical value = pairing squared, corrected by unsquare (counted). 16-19% fewer M-eq than Jacobian Miller at 28-52-bit r.
